what: Loop (1) moved onto the one ask behind `AsksMet`, but the board is per body store, not per request: a body's heads are filed into its own store, so a head another body published cannot be read from the board without filing it again. The ask therefore saves no work across bodies yet; it bounds and names (cycles, depth, board full) and counts.
cost: no cross-body saving from loop (1) until a store can take a published head by reference; the question is still read again after a made fact (a read, no work redone)
cause: the store owns its head rows (`Store<'n>` with `RefCell` and `Cell` fields): a fact made by one task is not readable by another task's store in place
whys: heads are filed per store from frozen records; the frozen table is shared, the filed rows are not
class: a per-task cache where a shared record belongs (rule 51)
prevention: the request's board over the FrozenTable's cells, with a store reading filed heads from the table in place (no per-store copy); then one board per request and `ONE_TASK` goes
annoyance: write-only lane: the oracle (`--features asks-oracle`) and its control cannot be run here
workaround: the seam keeps both paths; the oracle runs every body any test checks both ways
